messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync — are we green for marketplace launch next Wed? Need final signoffs for press, microsite, SI docs, and HW partner assets. TL;DR: staging cutover Thurs midnight PT. Who's owning what?

Tom: I'm on press. Draft embargo ready, waiting on legal redlines. @Samira can you confirm logos + trademark usage?

Samira: On it. Legal asked for logo variants + partner MSA snippet. Sending in channel in 15m. Also pinging design for dark BG assets :+1:

Jeri: Landing page is staged and the trial flow is tested. CTA works, signup funnel good. Need final hero copy from marketing and a short FAQ for the microsite; will wire in once I get copy.

Nico: SI integrations doc updated with runbook and auth scopes (added SSO appendix). Heads up — one systems integrator still needs an SSO cert and a bit of custom config. @Tom can we avoid naming them in the public partner list until they finish?

Tom: Yes — we can say "select partners" and update the public list after launch. Press embargo remains Wed 10:00am PT. Please keep that tight.

Maya (Partnerships): Plan we discussed: press + blog embargo Wed 10:00am PT; public listing live Wed 11:00am PT; staging->prod cutover Thurs 00:00 PT. Jeri -> deploy landing by 9:00am Wed for final smoke. Samira -> confirm logos by EOD Tue. Nico -> confirm SI exceptions by EOD Tue.

Samira: Confirming EOD Tue. Uploaded logos to staging storage at /assets/partners/marketplace (staging). Included 3 variants per partner (light, dark, mono).

Jeri: Got the files. One SVG needs a tiny CSS tweak on mobile (overflow). I'll push a patch in ~20m and re-run the smoke.

launch-bot: deploybot: scheduled cutover window recorded — staging -> prod: 2765434000. Reminder: run smoke tests, disable promo banners pre-cutover, and tag release with "marketplace-launch-v1".

Maya (Partnerships): Two asks before I finalize the checklist doc: (1) can someone write a short 3-bullet PR for press about what NOT to imply (compliance/lawsuits/etc)? (2) Eng — confirm rollback plan if listing causes high RPS or unexpected DB load.

Nico: I'll draft the PR bullets. First pass will include: do not imply SOC2 completion; avoid naming unreleased partner integrations; don't disclose customer data. Will post in this thread. Alex, can you confirm rollback/runbook? @Alex (Infra)

Alex (Infra): Rollback plan in short: revert DNS to staging mirror, disable marketplace write paths, and divert traffic to static listing (read-only) — estimated RTO 15m. Will prepare a one-page runbook and attach in #eng-ops. Smoke tests included in the runbook.

Maya (Partnerships): Perfect — thanks all. I'll assemble the final checklist and ping legal + marketing once logos, SI exceptions, and runbook links are in. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: if your item is on track. :rocket:
